completionEvidence.description: The real model scrolled the Epiphany test page to BOTTOM MARKER; the window title became bottom-reached.
The model then attempted repeated drags (38 tool executions total) but the page never reached bottom-and-drag-ok and the run exceeded the 240-second settle timeout.
A guest-side xdotool control test reproduced dragstart without dragenter/dragover on the drop target, so the failure is not attributed to model coordinate choice alone.

error.message: Epiphany 46.5 on the validated X11 stack starts HTML5 drag but does not deliver the drop with synthetic XTEST input; scrolling itself passed.

notes: This is a real negative result and a known browser limitation to address or document. Window-manager drag was separately verified with the guest agent.
